title: Isabel
creator: CrossFit
description: Thirty snatches at 135/95 lb for time. Introduced in 2004 as Grace's companion, it is a fast test of snatch technique and stamina; power snatches are fine. Scale the bar until you can cycle singles or small sets without breaking form.
